en: Black‑and‑white view over a dense row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses along a narrow street or promenade at the foot of a wooded hillside. The architecture is ornate, with gabled roofs, dormer windows and decorative facades. Ground floors contain shops and cafés with striped awnings and outdoor seating. One prominent building in the foreground bears the sign "HÔTEL HANNOVER." Other painted signs advertise a pharmacy and chemical or laboratory establishments. Pedestrians are visible below near a small monument or statue.
